parsed.evidence: The white support panel in both the close and wide views isolates a specific patch of land. In the wide context image, this location corresponds to a area of green, textured ground cover situated between tilled brown fields and darker tree lines. The color is a muted green, distinct from the deep green of the surrounding forest (trees) and the bare brown of the plowed soil. This appearance is characteristic of grassy areas, crops, or general low-lying vegetation.
